finding: A supported in-app file chooser uploaded a six-page PDF and the stored attachment matched the original bytes. Buffer rendered all pages before save but returned numPages 0 and a blank carousel preview after reopening. One reattachment and connector re-save reproduced the issue. Native LinkedIn processed all six pages and preserved a manually saved draft. Treat Buffer document preview as unresolved; never infer publication or retry blindly.

evidence.result: Draft and source-file integrity verified; Buffer saved preview incomplete; native unscheduled draft verified. Krish retains final publication.

revisit_when: Buffer saved document metadata/preview changes; perform a bounded check on the exact draft and never duplicate or publish to test.
